# Third-party code and fonts shipped in this repo

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vendor/supabase.js` | [supabase-js](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js) (UMD build) | 2.119.0 | MIT |
| `assets/fonts/tiny5-latin.woff2` | [Tiny5](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Tiny5) via Google Fonts | latin subset | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `assets/fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght.woff2` | [JetBrains Mono](https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/) via Google Fonts | latin subset | SIL OFL 1.1 |

The cars, avatars, trophy, flags, digits and icons are pixel grids drawn by hand for Type Race (`assets/js/sprites.js`) and rendered as SVG; no image generation was used.
